why: Both share the same strong industrial core (aged brown leather sofa, wood-and-black-metal table and bookcase, black metal lamp). A's larger rug brings rust and terracotta accents, echoed by the rust cushions, which warm up the exposed beams; its blue base is only a near miss on 'earth tones'. B's grey-black rug with white fringe drifts further from the earthy palette the client asked for.
